Explain how a VPN works in simple words
7:54 PM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and another computer on the internet. Everything you send goes through that tunnel scrambled, so your internet provider or a public Wi-Fi owner sees only gibberish.

The VPN computer then visits websites for you, so they see its address instead of yours. That hides where you are and keeps your activity private on shared networks.

It doesn't make you invisible, though. The VPN company can still see your traffic, so pick one you trust.
